### Stacked bar graphs

Stacked bar graphs are used to compare totals across categories while also showing how each total is divided among subgroups. Each bar represents a category, and the segments within the bar represent the contribution of each subgroup to the overall total.

:::{.callout-note icon="false"}

### Bar graph with error bars

Bar graphs with error bars are used to compare means across categories while showing the variability or uncertainty of those estimates.

:::{.callout-note icon='false'}
